text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for >100,000 CFU/mL Staphylococcus aureus, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria is noted. Glucosuria is abnormal and may warrant evaluation for hyperglycemia/diabetes. Low specific gravity suggests dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation and further assessment for possible underlying diabetes and urinary tract infection management.
